name: Ultimate Guitar Tabs
author: Carmine Paolino
description: Shows the Ultimate Guitar tab for whatever you are playing. It picks the track up from your media player, finds the best-rated tab for it, and renders it in the bar with auto-scroll, a version switcher, and text sizing.

barWidget.description: The tab for the song you are playing, for guitar, bass, ukulele, or drums.

schema.label: Instrument
schema.description: Which instrument's tab to look for. The reader has its own picker that overrides this once you use it; songs nobody tabbed for that instrument fall back to guitar.

schema.label: Expanded width (% of screen)
schema.description: How wide the reader grows when expanded with the button in its header. It always opens compact.

schema.label: Expanded height (% of screen)
schema.description: The tallest the reader may grow when expanded. Short tabs still shrink the panel to fit.

schema.label: Hide when nothing is playing
schema.description: Keep the bar clear until a player reports a track.
